infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill Line partial closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Saturday 1 to Friday 7 November, L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will not run between Central and Convention due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.

  • L1 light rail services will continue to run between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • Use alternative transport including regular bus services, L1 replacement bus services, or walking if able to, between Central Grand Concourse and Convention.
  • Due to road closures, L1 replacement buses will only stop at Central Grand Concourse, Convention and The Star. There will be no replacement buses at the following stops: Capitol Square, Paddy’s Markets, Exhibition Centre, Pyrmont Bay.
L1 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am on Saturday 8 November.
 
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
